name: sapportly-sdk-repo
description: Public Git repository for Sapportly SDKs: @sapportly/sdk and @sapportly/widget-sdk (npm org sapportly, not supportly)

scripts.test: pnpm --dir typescript test && pnpm --dir widget test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir typescript typecheck && pnpm --dir widget typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --dir typescript build && pnpm --dir widget build
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --dir typescript pack --dry-run && pnpm --dir widget pack --dry-run
